shortDescription: Manages service offerings on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: cpu_number
options.description: The number of CPUs of the service offering.

options.name: cpu_speed
options.description: The CPU speed of the service offering in MHz.

options.name: deployment_planner
options.description: The deployment planner heuristics used to deploy a VM of this offering. If not set, the value of global config I(vm.deployment.planner) is used.

options.name: disk_bytes_read_rate
options.description: Bytes read rate of the disk offering.

options.name: disk_bytes_write_rate
options.description: Bytes write rate of the disk offering.

options.name: disk_iops_max
options.description: Max. iops of the compute offering.

options.name: disk_iops_min
options.description: Min. iops of the compute offering.

options.name: disk_iops_read_rate
options.description: IO requests read rate of the disk offering.

options.name: disk_iops_write_rate
options.description: IO requests write rate of the disk offering.

options.name: display_text
options.description: Display text of the service offering. If not set, I(name) will be used as I(display_text) while creating.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the service offering is related to. Public for all domains and subdomains if not set.

options.name: host_tags
options.description: The host tags for this service offering.

options.name: hypervisor_snapshot_reserve
options.description: Hypervisor snapshot reserve space as a percent of a volume. Only for managed storage using Xen or VMware.

options.name: is_customized
options.description: Whether the offering is customizable or not.

options.name: is_iops_customized
options.description: Whether compute offering iops is custom or not.

options.name: is_system
options.description: Whether it is a system VM offering or not.

options.name: is_volatile
options.description: Whether the virtual machine needs to be volatile or not. Every reboot of VM the root disk is detached then destroyed and a fresh root disk is created and attached to VM.

options.name: limit_cpu_usage
options.description: Restrict the CPU usage to committed service offering.

options.name: memory
options.description: The total memory of the service offering in MB.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the service offering.

options.name: network_rate
options.description: Data transfer rate in Mb/s allowed. Supported only for non-system offering and system offerings having I(system_vm_type=domainrouter).

options.name: offer_ha
options.description: Whether HA is set for the service offering.

options.name: provisioning_type
options.description: Provisioning type used to create volumes.

options.name: service_offering_details
options.description: Details for planner, used to store specific parameters. A list of dictionaries having keys C(key) and C(value).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the service offering.

options.name: storage_tags
options.description: The storage tags for this service offering.

options.name: storage_type
options.description: The storage type of the service offering.

options.name: system_vm_type
options.description: The system VM type. Required if I(is_system=true).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
